title: Transforming Education through Smart Classrooms in SC-Dominated Villages: A Digital Learning Initiative in Kathua, Jammu and Kashmir
body_text:
Under the Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM-AJAY), District Kathua has taken significant strides towards bridging the digital divide in rural and border areas by establishing Smart Classrooms in Government Schools located in SC-dominated villages.
During the year 2022-23, a total of 07 Smart Classrooms were established under the PM-AJAY component in different Government Schools of SC-dominated villages. Notably, these included Chack Chabba and Chack Nathal, villages located near the International Border, and Village Sandhi, situated in the remotest sub-division of Bani. Each Smart Classroom included installation of Interactive Touch Panels, procurement of student furniture, and execution of essential civil works such as child-friendly wall paintings and electrification.
Building upon this success, 04 additional Smart Classrooms were established during 2023-24 under the same component. Further, in 2025-26, 03 more Smart Classrooms were added, thereby expanding the outreach of digital education in the district.
The establishment of Smart Classrooms has significantly enhanced the overall learning experience of students in rural and far-flung areas. Access to modern teaching tools, audio-visual content, and interactive learning—once limited to expensive private schools—has now reached Government Schools in remote villages with limited exposure to the outside world. For many students, modern digital education, once a distant dream, has become a reality, leading to improved classroom engagement, conceptual clarity, and academic outcomes.

enrichment.summary: Under the Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM-AJAY), District Kathua in Jammu and Kashmir has established Smart Classrooms in Government Schools in SC-dominated villages, including border villages Chack Chabba and Chack Nathal and remote Sandhi village in Bani sub-division. Seven classrooms were set up in 2022-23, four more in 2023-24, and three additional in 2025-26, totaling 14 Smart Classrooms equipped with interactive touch panels, furniture, and civil works. The initiative aims to bridge the digital divide and improve learning outcomes for students in remote and border areas.
enrichment.context: PM-AJAY is a centrally sponsored scheme launched in 2021-22 by merging three earlier schemes—Special Central Assistance to Scheduled Castes Sub Plan, Babu Jagjivan Ram Chhatrawas Yojana (hostels), and Pradhan Mantri Adarsh Gram Yojana (PMAGY)—aimed at the socio-economic development of Scheduled Castes through village-level infrastructure, grants-in-aid to states, and skill development. Its 'Adarsh Gram' component focuses on developing SC-majority villages by filling infrastructure and social gaps, including education, which this Kathua initiative exemplifies. Digital education infrastructure in remote and border districts also aligns with broader government priorities such as the Digital India and Samagra Shiksha initiatives, which seek to reduce the urban-rural and private-public school divide. Kathua's proximity to the International Border adds a strategic dimension, as improving public infrastructure and services in border villages also supports the government's Vibrant Villages Programme objective of reversing outmigration from border areas by improving quality of life.

National Rural Livelihood Mission, MGNREGA, and PM Awas Yojana
Ayushman Bharat, Jan Aushadhi Yojana, and Poshan Abhiyan
prelims_questions.explanation: PM-AJAY was launched by merging the Special Central Assistance to Scheduled Castes Sub Plan, Babu Jagjivan Ram Chhatrawas Yojana (hostels), and Pradhan Mantri Adarsh Gram Yojana (PMAGY), all aimed at the socio-economic upliftment of Scheduled Castes.

prelims_questions.question: Which Ministry administers the Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM-AJAY), under which Smart Classrooms were set up in Kathua district?
prelims_questions.explanation: PM-AJAY is implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, which released this information about Smart Classrooms established under the scheme in Kathua, Jammu and Kashmir.

mains_questions.question: Discuss the objectives and components of the Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM-AJAY). How can infrastructure interventions like Smart Classrooms in SC-dominated villages contribute to the socio-economic empowerment of Scheduled Castes?
Examine the significance of providing digital education infrastructure in border and remote villages for national integration and the strategic development of border areas.
